answer: There are a few options for a late-night grocery store or pharmacy in Gulberg III. You can find one at The Monal, which is near Liberty Chowk. It's an indoor and outdoor seating place with a total sky view of the bustling city. You can also find a pharmacy at 6 Liberty Market (Gulberg). Both places are open late.
guest_message: Is there a grocery store or pharmacy nearby that's open late?

Costa Nostra. Authentic Italian food, overseen by Pak-Italian owners. It has a reservation-only, high-end gourmet experience with a rather well put-together table d'hote, and it has a basement pizzeria where you can't go wrong if want a pizza pie that resembles something from Rome and not Chicago.

The Monal, in Gulberg III near Liberty Chowk, roundabout. It on the top of Liberty Park Plaza. You have to climb up the plaza by a car, but be careful to drive slowly and look in the traffic mirrors to see if a car is coming from the upper floor when you're about to climb up in the plaza. 6 Liberty Market (Gulberg). A large circular market with hundreds of shops selling clothing, electronics, and so on. A basement shop in Liberty (tell the rickshaw driver it's near H Karim Bakhsh) has good handicrafts, and can be bargained with. (updated Feb 2017)
